rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: Withheld: the twin keys SDO and SDO.JO are one issuer but published different figures for the same period. The figure backed by the issuer's own filing () is served there; this key's conflicting figure is removed so one issuer does not carry two.
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024, FY2022; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2023: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
